text:
Maria: NimbleHealth (SG) reporting sudden 502 spikes and intermittent 401s since 04:20 UTC. They see requests land in us-east even though geoip policy should route to ap-southeast-1. Affected path: POST /v1/generate. Customer says latency up and billing spike from client retries.
Devon: Can you paste dig +curl -v outputs and the Host/SNI? Also is it one customer or multiple?
Maria: Single high-volume customer for now. Dig result from their resolver: 
```
; <<>> DiG 9.11.3 <<>> api.redwood.example
;; ANSWER SECTION:
api.redwood.example. 60 IN A 3.210.45.12  ; us-east edge
```
Curl verbose snippet: 
```
> POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
> Host: api.redwood.example
> Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< x-edge-pop: us-east-1
```
Oscar: deploy-bot alerted route-fallbacks at 04:18 UTC, multiple SIN edges fell back to us-east due to geoip lookup errors on 3 nodes. Auth validation fails when proxied cross-region because token audience is regional.
deploy-bot: [alert] route-fallback spike: geoip_miss_rate=0.32 edges affected: sin-3, sin-5, sin-7
Alex: Quick checks - GeoIP DB sync for APAC shard last completed 23:50 UTC yesterday, so there may be stale mapping combined with client resolver caches. Also some ISPs strip EDNS/ecs which returns nonlocal A answers.
Lia: Customer reports a billing surge from client-side retries. They retried multiple times when they saw 502/401, causing extra billed tokens. Need billing review and a possible credit.
Devon: Repro steps for ENG: 1) dig @8.8.8.8 api.redwood.example +short, 2) dig +subnet (or set EDNS client subnet) to compare answers, 3) curl --resolve api.redwood.example:443:3.210.45.12 -v to force us-east and observe auth behavior, 4) simulate without ECS to see nonlocal routing.
Oscar: Temp mitigation suggestions: purge geoip cache on affected sin nodes and set fallback policy to prefer local-region answers where possible to avoid auth audience mismatch. Increase route decision jitter/TTL to 30s to reduce oscillation while we investigate.
Alex: Purge command for edge (internal):
```
curl -X POST https://infra-api.internal/edges/sin-3/cache/purge -H 'Authorization: Bearer <infra-token>' -d 'key=geoip-db'
```
Maria: Customer-side guidance sent: flush DNS cache, stop automatic client retries for 60s, and provide resolver trace. They will attach pcap and resolver logs to the ticket.
Devon: Created ENG ticket ENG-9123 to track: faster geoip sync retries, healthchecks, and telemetry to detect cross-region auth audience mismatches.
Lia: Billing assigned to finance for review and potential pro-rated credit if spike linked to routing bug.
Oscar: Escalated to eng-sre for follow-up and added a postmortem placeholder. Please attach any additional repro logs to ENG-9123.
Maria: Attaching customer pcap + resolver trace to the ticket in a sec.
